subject: Surge onboarding credit top-up request — NodeFound cohort
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nodefound.co>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Morton <lmorton@edutech.io>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: top-up of onboarding promo codes for June cohort

Diego,

Quick note from NodeFound — our June onboarding cohort just grew unexpectedly (partner referral spike) and we've got ~120 new attendees who need access tokens for the demo environment. We previously planned for 250 seats; we now need an extra 120 promo/trial credits to cover their API access during the first week.

Can Redwood authorize a one-off top-up (trial credits) or reallocate from our partner pool? We can sign a short addendum if needed — want to avoid any churn during the first 7 days.

I've attached a proposed roster and rough schedule. Happy to jump on a quick call if you need context.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Developer Programs
NodeFound Inc.

Attachments: onboarding-roster.xlsx (spreadsheet), promo_request_notes.txt (plain text)
From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nodefound.co>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: top-up of onboarding promo codes for June cohort

On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 09:12 Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nodefound.co> wrote:
> Diego,
>
> Quick note from NodeFound — our June onboarding cohort just grew unexpectedly (partner referral spike) and we've got ~120 new attendees who need access tokens for the demo environment.
>
> Can Redwood authorize a one-off top-up (trial credits) or reallocate from our partner pool?

Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the spike. Looping in Marissa from partnerships to coordinate the promo pool and legal/ops details.

Marissa — can you confirm available credit balance in the NodeFound partner allocation and whether we can push a one-time 120-seat top-up? If ops needs an MOU or DocuSign, we'll get that signed today.

Diego
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nodefound.co>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: top-up of onboarding promo codes for June cohort

Diego / Karthik —

I pulled the partner allocation ledger: NodeFound has 6,000 trial units in their pool; 4,850 are already committed to scheduled cohorts and partner promos. That leaves ~1,150 units free on paper — more than enough, but the catch is that 420 units are earmarked for a delayed cohort (approval pending) and not easily movable without an ops note.

Proposal: we can temporarily reallocate 120 units to the June cohort as a one-time surge if Karthik signs off. Ops will need the attached CSV (promo_batch.csv) with the token mapping and the roster. We should also include a short mutual action plan item that Sanjay signs — 7-day activation window and basic usage limits to prevent over-consumption.

Costs: nominal — equivalent to ~0.02 credits per seat for the week under current pricing assumptions. I flagged finance for visibility (cc'd Laura).

Sanay (Sanjay) — if you can return the signed mutual_action_plan.docx by Monday 6/1 EOD, ops can push the tokens by Tuesday morning. If you need the tokens earlier, let me know and I'll escalate for a same-day exception.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: promo_batch.csv, mutual_action_plan.docx
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@nodefound.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: top-up of onboarding promo codes for June cohort

Marissa / Diego —

Approvable. Authorize a temporary transfer of 120 trial units from NodeFound's existing partner pool to the June onboarding roster. Ops: please implement the top-up after we receive the signed mutual_action_plan.docx. Finance (Laura) — flag for the partner ledger reconciliation; we'll record this as a one-off reallocation (Deal: NF-2026-Q2-089).

Diego — please confirm once tokens are live so Sanjay can proceed with the cohort communications. Sanjay — appreciate the quick turnaround on the signed doc; I'll personally route any urgent exceptions if you need same-day provisioning.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none. Forwarded note: promo_batch.csv referenced in Marissa's email.
